annotations.title: Get one listing as a record

description: Get one live LucyESL job listing by its numeric id as a structured record: employer and employer type, region, pay in KRW, teaching and on-site hours, housing, visas, benefits, contract length, start date, dates, and the facts the advert left unstated (null means not stated). An id that has closed or expired returns an error naming it.
